sections.text_helper: Section 31.13 "DWT (data watchpoint trigger)" in chapter 31 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 1097.
sections.section_content:
The DWT unit consists of four comparators. They are configurable as:
• a hardware watchpoint or
• a trigger to an ETM or
• a PC sampler or
• a data address sampler
The DWT also provides some means to give some profiling informations. For this, some
counters are accessible to give the number of:
• Clock cycle
• Folded instructions
• Load store unit (LSU) operations
• Sleep cycles
• CPI (clock per instructions)
• Interrupt overhead
